review: The source implements quotient modules over fields with canonical lift/retraction maps and finite-field examples. This is primary evidence that quotienting vector spaces and reconstructing representatives are established. It does not establish prior publication of this exact bounded nonwrapping interval frontier or a complete novel generalized rootfinding solver;no such novelty claim is made. The new contribution under test is integration of exact joint original-domain representatives with certified translation-line correction and charged reconstruction/output.
caution: Prime intervals are not vector subspaces. Their first-zero integer chart requires p>2M;the explicit wrap counterexample is retained.
